name: Kyonyuu Sugite Kirawareteru kamo!? to Nayanderu Yuujin no Muchi Kanojo o Haramase Onaho ni Shita Ken
original_name: 巨乳すぎて嫌われてるかも！？と悩んでる友人の無知彼女を孕ませオナホにした件
source:
Your pal gives you a pretty hardcore inferiority complex, he always seems to be one step ahead of you in life, work, relationships, EVERYTHING! She hardly seems to react at all which is pretty wild considering you were just talking about how you’d kill to bury your face in her mega milkers thinking you dodged a bullet you go on with your day like normal until later that night you get a text from a strange number, its Rina! Looks like she’s a little concerned that her relationship with your friend isn’t progressing and she’s worried it’s because of her boobs?!

Well, if your bro isn’t gonna make a move this is your moment to quickstep in front of your buddy by graduating from your virginity first but by fucking his girlfriend to do it, talk about a violation of the bro code… YEAH RIGHT!

好家伙，既然你的好兄弟迟迟不敢出手，那正是你抢先一步比死党更早告别处男之身的绝佳良机——只不过对象是他的女朋友罢了。这可真是把兄弟义气踩在脚底下摩擦啊……管他呢，爽就完了！
